verses.text: “My Son, take it not sadly to heart, if any think ill of thee, and say of thee what thou art unwilling to hear.
verses.modernizedText: “My Son, do not take it sadly to heart if any think ill of you, and say of you what you are unwilling to hear.

verses.text: Thou oughtest to think worse of thyself, and to believe no man weaker than thyself.
verses.modernizedText: You ought to think worse of yourself, and to believe no man weaker than yourself.

verses.text: If thou walkest inwardly, thou wilt not weigh flying words above their value.
verses.modernizedText: If you walk inwardly, you will not weigh flying words above their value.

verses.text: It is no small prudence to keep silence in an evil time and to turn inwardly unto Me, and not to be troubled by human judgment.
verses.modernizedText: It is no small prudence to keep silence in an evil time and to turn inwardly to Me, and not to be troubled by human judgment.

verses.text: “Let not thy peace depend upon the word of men; for whether they judge well or ill of thee, thou art not therefore any other man than thyself.
verses.modernizedText: “Do not let your peace depend upon the word of men; for whether they judge well or ill of you, you are not therefore any other man than yourself.

verses.text: Where is true peace or true glory?
verses.modernizedText: Where is true peace or true glory?

verses.text: And he who seeketh not to please men, nor feareth to displease, shall enjoy abundant peace.
verses.modernizedText: And he who does not seek to please men, or fear to displease, will enjoy abundant peace.

verses.text: From inordinate love and vain fear ariseth all disquietude of heart, and all distraction of the senses.”
verses.modernizedText: From inordinate love and vain fear arise all disquietude of heart, and all distraction of the senses.”
